a: Vue is a progressive JavaScript framework for building UIs.
Composition API organizes logic with setup(), ref, and reactive.
Options API uses data, methods, computed, and lifecycle hooks objects.
Vue Router maps URLs to components in SPA navigation.
Pinia is the official state management library for Vue.
Svelte compiles components to efficient vanilla JS at build time.
Stores hold reactive shared state in Svelte apps.
SvelteKit is the full-stack framework for Svelte apps.
Both are component UIs; Vue is often simpler to start, React has a larger ecosystem.
Reactivity updates the UI when underlying state changes.
